mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year indicates inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases do not correlate with positive 5-day forward returns in > 55% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines do not correlate with negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases simultaneously, it indicates a strong labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and subsequently higher interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint increase in PAYEMS and decrease in UNRATE does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for economic growth and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases do not lead to positive 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2%, it signals a potential economic slowdown due to tight monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the joint condition of FEDFUNDS > 2% and GDPC1 growth < 2% does not lead to negative 60-day forward returns in > 50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a recessionary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines sharply and UNRATE rises
failure_condition: If the joint decline in INDPRO and rise in UNRATE does not lead to negative 20-day forward returns in > 60% of instances.
